dialogue.chat: I'm glad you came to talk. Truly. Sit — and don't rush whatever it is.
dialogue.chat/1: I'm so glad you came. Sit — take your time with whatever it is.
dialogue.chat/2: Talk to me. I've a soft ear and no clock, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations: Of course we can talk. You look like you're carrying something too — we'll trade. What's on your mind?
dialogue.conversations/1: Yes, let's talk. Come sit — you carry things quietly, I've noticed. So do I.
dialogue.conversations/2: Always. Whatever it is, I'll hold it gently, %1$s. Go on.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good: Truly good, for once. The bread came out right and the sunrise nearly made me cry. But how are YOU, really?
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/1: Softly good. The kind of day that could bring a tear if you let it. And you? Truly?
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/2: Good, and a little tender about it. Joy hits me square in the chest. But how are you?
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough: Heavy, honestly. And you asking just now — sorry, give me a moment. That meant something, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough/1: Heavy. I feel everything twice, I think. Your asking lightens it, %1$s. Genuinely.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again: You asked already, and it still touches me. I'm alright, truly. Are YOU, though? You keep checking on me.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again/1: Twice now — you sweet thing. Still the same, still warmed that you care enough to ask again.
dialogue.conversations.day.good: A gentle one. Cold well water, and the baker smiled at me. I keep those. You look tired, though — are you sleeping?
dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Gentle and kind. I collect the small mercies — a smile, cold water. You look worn, though. Rest tonight?
dialogue.conversations.day.rough: Hard. I heard the neighbors arguing and carried it all day like it was mine. I do that. Talking helps, so thank you.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: I took on the whole village's weather today. I do that. Talking it out helps — thank you for staying.
dialogue.conversations.work.like: I do. You can pour a whole mood into your hands and the work just... holds it for you. Does yours do that?
dialogue.conversations.work.like/1: I do. The work takes whatever mood I hand it and just... holds it. That's a quiet mercy.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate: Between us... it wears on me. Not the labor — the way nobody asks how it's going. You just did, though. I noticed.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate/1: Not the labor — the loneliness of it. Nobody asks how the day's going. You did. I won't forget it.
dialogue.conversations.village.home: %2$s holds a lot of quiet hearts, %1$s. I try to notice the ones that need noticing. It's home because of them.
dialogue.conversations.village.home/1: I love %2$s the way you love people — for the cracks as much as anything. Every worn doorstep has a story.
dialogue.conversations.people.first: Good souls, all carrying something. I feel it when one of them is struggling, even across the square. I bring bread.
dialogue.conversations.people.first/1: They're precious to me, honestly. I know who hasn't smiled this week, and I make it my business to fix it.
dialogue.conversations.food.first: Something shared, at a warm table. Food's love made edible, %1$s — that's not just a saying to me.
dialogue.conversations.food.first/1: The inn's stew when the whole family's there. It's never really about the food. It's the faces around it.
dialogue.conversations.life.first: No one's asked so gently before. It's an ordinary story — but there's a winter in it my eyes still sting over. Sit close.
dialogue.conversations.life.first/1: You asked so kindly. It's an ordinary tale with one winter I still cry over. Sit close, I'll trust you with it.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first: A house where nobody leaves the table angry. That's it, that's the whole dream. Small, isn't it? It doesn't feel small.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first/1: A table nobody leaves angry from. That's all. It sounds small and it isn't, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first: That someone I love will be hurting right in front of me and I'll miss it. I check faces the way the guard checks the wall.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first/1: Missing someone's pain when it's right in front of me. I read faces all day for the signs.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first: You listen with your whole face, %1$s. Do you know how rare that is? Around you I don't have to be the strong one.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first/1: With you I get to set the weight down. You've no idea what that's worth to someone like me.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal: You're kind to ask — I felt that. But that story still bruises, and I'd want to trust the hands I put it in. Give us time?
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal/: You asked so gently — I felt it. But that story still bruises. Let me learn to trust the hands first?
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate: Gently, %1$s... not yet. That answer lives somewhere very soft. Keep being how you are, and one day it walks out on its own.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate/: Not yet, %1$s. That one lives somewhere very tender. Keep being kind, and it'll come out on its own.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: Nothing spoken, anyway. But the mason's been quieter than usual and I don't like it. I'll bring him bread. That's the news.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none/1: Nothing spoken. But the mason's gone quiet, and quiet worries me. I'll bring bread. That's my kind of news.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes: Happy? You let me be soft without flinching, %1$s. Do you know how safe that feels? Yes. Endlessly yes.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes/1: With you the tears are mostly the good kind now. That's everything to me. Yes, love.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.marriage: %2$s and %3$s were married, %1$s — I cried through the whole thing. Two hearts choosing each other out loud... it undoes me every time.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.marriage/1: Oh, %2$s and %3$s wed! I'm still dabbing my eyes. When they looked at each other I felt it right in my chest. Weddings ruin me, gladly.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.divorce: %2$s and %3$s have parted, and my heart aches for them both — there's no villain in a thing like that, just two people hurting. I've brought them each some bread.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.divorce/1: %2$s and %3$s split, and I've felt it all week. Love ending is its own kind of grief, %1$s. I just want to sit with them both.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.death: We lost %2$s. I've cried more than I'd admit — some souls leave a room so much emptier. Come here, %1$s. Grief's lighter shared.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.death/1: %2$s passed, and my heart hasn't stopped aching. They mattered so much more than words can hold. I'll carry them a long while.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth: %2$s was born! Oh, I wept the happy kind of tears — a brand-new heartbeat in the village. Nothing on this earth moves me like it.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth/1: There's a new baby, %2$s, and I'm just overflowing, %1$s. Those tiny fingers... I can't. Pure joy, right through me.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.arrival: %2$s moved in, and I've already decided to love them. A new soul among us — I want them to feel held from the very first day.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.arrival/1: Someone new — %2$s — has come to stay. My heart just opens for the newly-arrived. I brought them soup and probably cried on the doorstep.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.departure: %2$s left us for good, and I felt every step of that goodbye. Partings tear at me, %1$s. I already miss the sound of their door.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.departure/: %2$s has gone away. I stood waving until they were out of sight, tears and all. The village keeps a little emptier now, right here in my chest.
